visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a blue patterned apron and a purple mask is seen at a breakfast stall, handling stacked bamboo steamers on a stainless steel counter. The lighting is bright and natural, indicating an outdoor or semi-outdoor morning setting. (2) A close-up view shows a hand in a blue nitrile glove using a large knife to slice horizontally through a white, fluffy steamed bun on a flat griddle surface. (3) The gloved hand places the sliced bun into a heavy metallic panini press. The background shows a busy food stall environment with various containers and a griddle. (4) The panini press is opened to reveal the bun, now bearing distinct golden-brown grill marks on its top surface. (5) Using tongs, the woman layers pieces of grilled meat, a slice of ham, fresh cucumber strips, and a fried egg seasoned with green powder into the grilled bun. (6) A close-up shot features the completed sandwich being held up toward the camera, showcasing its thick layers including fresh lettuce and succulent meat. (7) A different bun with a brownish hue is sliced open, and a mixture of chocolate and peanut sauce is spread inside, revealing a creamy and viscous texture. (8) The scene shifts to the exterior of the shop, showing a yellow menu sign, a scooter parked in front, and a person in a red shirt working at the griddle.
